Pure Pixiv illustration, manga, and novel browsing

Huiguang is a third-party client for Pixiv offering illustration, manga, and novel browsing, search, and reading. After you agree to this notice, the app connects to the network to load official Pixiv and Pixivision content and sync your author follows and work bookmarks (favorited tags are kept locally only and never uploaded or synced; visiting the About page or explicitly tapping Check for updates also sends an anonymous read-only request to GitHub to show the developer\'s public profile or check release metadata). When saving original artworks or exporting novel text files, the app writes files to your device\'s Download folder (or a user-selected directory authorized via Settings → Storage → Download location) and stores your login session Cookie locally encrypted (passwords are never read or stored). We do not collect or upload personal privacy data.

Welcome to Huiguang. Before using this app, please carefully read and review the following user agreement and privacy notice:

Huiguang is an unofficial third-party Pixiv client intended solely for personal study, technical research, and daily browsing.\n\nAll artworks, rankings, Pixivision features, and account data displayed are fetched directly from Pixiv\'s official services; this app hosts or redistributes no content.

Network permission is used to connect to official Pixiv (pixiv.net, pximg.net, embed.pixiv.net) and Pixivision (pixivision.net) services to load artwork details, media resources, novel contents, tag covers, and search results. Inside the official Pixiv sign-in WebView only, third-party login and bot-verification services integrated by Pixiv (Google, reCAPTCHA, Cloudflare, Apple, X) may be loaded as needed.

When you explicitly tap Follow author or Bookmark work, the client communicates directly with Pixiv's official servers to sync state without forwarding any interaction records to third-party servers; favorited tags are saved locally only and are never uploaded or synced.

When you visit the About page or explicitly tap Check for updates, the app sends an anonymous read-only request to GitHub (api.github.com, github.com, and *.githubusercontent.com) via an isolated clean HTTP client—without any Pixiv Referer, cookies, locale headers, or user/device identifiers—to fetch the developer's public profile, release metadata, or an APK installer you confirm to download. External links in About (repository, Telegram group, and open-source project homepages) are only opened or copied when you explicitly tap them.

Sign-in runs exclusively inside Pixiv's official web page. Your password is never seen, read, or stored; your session Cookie is encrypted locally using Android Keystore, and signing out clears the local encrypted session, WebView cookies/caches, local favorite/follow caches, account-scoped caches, and image/update caches.

Original artworks and exported novel TXT files are written by default to the system public Download directory, or to a custom folder you authorize through the system file picker under Settings → Storage → Download location (which can be reset at any time).

Browsing history, favorited tags, custom share templates, reading typography, bookmark caches, skipped update version tags, home feed cache, image disk cache, and temporary APK update downloads are stored in private local app storage with cloud backup and device-to-device transfer disabled.

Huiguang operates no custom backend and collects, analyzes, or uploads zero behavioral data, device identifiers, or personal information.\n\nPlease use reasonable request rates and comply with Pixiv\'s Terms of Use. Users assume responsibility for any account risks from third-party client usage.

"Pixiv", "Pixivision", and related logos and trademarks belong to Pixiv Inc.

All illustrations, manga, novels, covers, and embedded images displayed belong to their respective creators or rights holders.

The app launcher artwork and project visual assets remain subject to their respective creator rights for app identification only; do not use downloaded or exported works for commercial purposes, nor redistribute or repost them without explicit permission from the original author.

The user interface is built upon the open-source COUI-Kit project under MPL-2.0 and its upstream TRADEMARKS.md policy.\n\nAll "ColorOS" related names and trademarks belong to Guangdong OPPO Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

This app has no official affiliation, authorization, partnership, or endorsement with Pixiv Inc. or any device manufacturer.\n\nHuiguang is provided "as is" without liability for service disruptions, functional changes, or data discrepancies caused by official API updates, network issues, or force majeure.

Huiguang v0.1.5 Release Notes
✨ What's New & Improvements
• Author Page Experience: Unified smooth scrolling across the bio, category bar, and work grids; switching between Illust, Manga, and Novel preserves each tab's scroll position without reloading, and improves contrast on the "Following" pill in dark mode.
• Search Tab Interactions: Scrolling down smoothly shrinks the search bar alongside the right "More" button; focusing expands it full-width with a "Cancel" button and lets you exit search input directly with the system back gesture.
• Search Results Upgrades: Added swipeable and clickable 3-tab paging across "Illust / Manga", "Novel", and "Authors", with a unified scroll-linked top bar and filter area.
• Global Navigation & State Retention: Unified top-left title collapse animations across "Home", "Search", and "Me"; switching between "Public / Private" bookmarks and changing History filters now keeps each tab's state and scroll position without reloading.
🐛 Bug Fixes
• Fixed Author Page Scroll Issues: Resolved getting stuck midway, erratic scrolling, or layout misplacement when scrolling back to the top after expanding a long bio or scrolling down the work list.
• Fixed Author Work Grid Alignment: Resolved work grids not aligning properly to the top on initial load or after switching categories.
• Fixed Home Section Switching Hang: Resolved getting stuck between "For You" and "Ranking" when tapping directly between "For You" and "Following" (or vice versa).
